prompt:
DIRECTION-LOCKED MOTION from a verified same-NPC view. IMAGE2 is the SAME NPC manually inspected SOUTHWEST directional neutral enlarged nearest8x, the EXACT camera/identity/physical-hand calibration to preserve in every frame. IMAGE3 is the SAME directional neutral RAW; costume and prop detail only. All three images are in the target direction. No Southeast sheet is an input. Preserve this own neutral head, robe, tools and physical handedness throughout all18poses; never swivel to front or Southeast to display a gesture.

Physical handedness: Spear gripped in anatomical RIGHT hand, free anatomical LEFT hand rests near route tag at anatomical LEFT hip. From FRONT spear grip projects screen-left; from BACK spear grip projects screen-right. Shaft remains low, tip down, never overhead. World floor is both boots, not spear tip.

Use case: real sprite animation production. Produce one transparent RGBA source sheet for this same accepted NPC: exactly6columns x3rows,18separated complete full-body poses. Request1536x1536. No labels, grid, text, scene, floor, shadow, FX, aura or particles. Each pose and every prop pixel must have generous clear alpha gutter, consistent column centers and row boot ground lines. Do not clip or touch neighboring poses. Row1 idle6, row2 talk6, row3 profession6. Row1frame1 is directional neutral calibration; one source-wide scale is measured from this neutral later. All other poses preserve physical scale; no per-pose bbox fitting. Native human standing body80px, base64x96/foot32,88; motion96x96/foot48,88 adds transparent padding only. Skull/main hair around half standing height, short torso/legs and broad crisp few-tone pixel clusters. Frame6 of each row should settle to its own directional frame1 neutral; this is a generation intent, not a claim of pixel-equal end frames.

IMAGE1 is the actual live Wang Lin Pixel02 neutral in the TARGET direction enlarged nearest8x: PRIMARY human anatomy, broad pixel treatment, material shading, camera and native scale. IMAGE2 is the SAME NPC manually inspected SOUTHWEST directional neutral enlarged nearest8x, the EXACT camera/identity/physical-hand calibration to preserve in every frame. IMAGE3 is the SAME directional neutral RAW; costume and prop detail only. All three images are in the target direction. No Southeast sheet is an input. Preserve this own neutral head, robe, tools and physical handedness throughout all18poses; never swivel to front or Southeast to display a gesture.

NPC Đinh Sóc / NPC-HN-GATE-WARDEN. Preserve compact dark hair, young adult face, dark blue-green robe, light copper duty shoulder marks, hip route tag and accepted short slim spear held low diagonal. Do not upscale the shaft to an overhead long spear, add helmet/shield/armor, or switch the tag side.

ALL18poses remain SOUTHWEST front-left three-quarter facing screen down-left, identical camera and body axes to IMAGE1. Show the true front-left view, never a mirrored Southeast sprite. Face, nearer sleeve and front robe are visible with appropriate far-side occlusion. The actor physical left/right costume and holding hands do not swap because the screen direction changed.

Prop continuity in every row: Spear remains gripped by the same original physical hand on the same physical flank through all18poses, tip down and clear of face. Only the original free physical hand checks the route tag. Do not reuse Southeast screen-left wording as handedness after rotation. Root/ground is between the boot soles, never the spear tip; low tip may extend into transparent padding below ground.

Keep original physical handedness/attachments as perspective changes. Use normal overlap/foreshortening and do not separate props from their grips to display them.

ROW IDLE6: frame1: Directional neutral calibration with both boots planted; frame2: Small inhalation in shoulders/cloth only; frame3: Slight sleeve/shoulder breathing change; frame4: Gentle exhalation without full-body bob or scaling; frame5: Subtle blink where eyes are actually visible, otherwise a settled shoulder/hair detail; frame6: Return to same source frame1 directional neutral.

ROW TALK6: frame1: Same directional standing neutral; frame2: Small speaking mouth shape only on actually visible face portion; frame3: Restrained head inclination/nod with slight shoulder change; do not turn toward viewer; frame4: Another visible speaking mouth shape as head nod begins to settle; frame5: Settle head/shoulders while both original prop hands remain low; frame6: Return to same source frame1 directional neutral.

ROW PROFESSION6: frame1: Directional standing guard neutral, same spear low in the original physical holding hand; frame2: Incline head slightly toward the existing hip route tag; frame3: Raise only the original free physical hand a small amount toward that tag; frame4: Check the same tag with free fingers; holding hand stays low and retains the spear; frame5: Lower free hand and settle head with only tiny original spear-wrist correction; frame6: Return to the same directional frame1 guard neutral.

Hair/robe/back construction is the minimal continuation of accepted identity: no extra emblems, pouches, decorations, hidden weapons, embroidery or face redesign. Motion is stationary with stable boots and genuine small pose changes; no six static duplicate images, full-body bobbing/scaling or camera rotation. Any naturally lower bounds while looking down remain natural, not normalized. New view/action is a candidate for review; owner acceptance of Southeast does not approve seven new views or runtime.
